Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
hamd...@my-deja.com wrote:
> If you were to drain all you vampires of blood in you master phase
> (eg Tribute to the Master), at what stage do they have to hunt?

Minions that are empty of blood must hunt before any other minion takes
an action.

> Can an action card be played first...

No.

> I play Tribute that leaves 4 of my vamps bone dry. Can I play Media
> Influence at sup and restore them all, or do they have to hunt first?

They have to hunt first.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook.html

6.1.2 Hunt (+1 stealth)

Any time during a Methuselah's minion phase that one of her ready
untapped vampires is empty (and not otherwise prohibited from hunting),
he must hunt immediately, before any other action is taken by any
minion. (If there are two or more such vampires, then their hunt actions
can be taken in whatever order the controller chooses.)

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <39695ad1...@news.supernews.com>,
cap...@thegateway.net writes

>Ex. I have a minion with 1 blood that takes an action, is blocked,
>plays Majesty and pays its last blood to untap. Is that minion
>Required to hunt?

Yes.

However, if the action that they took at the start of the turn is to
hunt already then, assuming you play with the No Repeat Actions rule
(you really should), you would be ineligible to hunt for a second time
during the same turn.
